title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**Responsibilities:**

Help with day\-to\-day operations related to sales efforts by the Customer success team.

On\-board patients on the Zyla platform; helping them understand the platform, benefits, and next steps associated with the program over voice and non voice process.

Lead and own the complete responsibility for the patient on\-boarding process.

Connecting with multiple stake holdersfrom different teams to ensure the on\-boarding process is smooth.

Ensuring correct registration of patient data across Zyla Data Centers.

**Additional Perks to join Zyla family**

Opportunity to directly work on a very innovative product that has a big societal impact.

Opportunity to work with a cross\-functional team consisting of leading medical brains, tech geeks, and operation gurus.

An open setup where you can innovate every day.

A home\-like office with home\-like perks:)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹350,000\.00 \- ₹450,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
